propositions: Contributor guidance does not instruct agents to fast-forward their own worktree after Gerrit merge, leading to shared main checkout clobbering when ticket close verification reads git history.

The close completion precheck (_referencing_commit_exists) verifies the merged rebar-ticket: commit is reachable from HEAD by running git log over repo_root, which fails if the fast-forward only happens to the shared checkout instead of the agent's worktree.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must be updated to explicitly document post-merge fast-forward discipline: fast-forward your personal worktree before close, never the shared main checkout.

Documentation must include both the positive directive (git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main in your worktree) and the negative constraint (never touch the shared main checkout, which may hold operator WIP).
